{{Quote|You try my patience, Bothan.''"<br />"''He will be here, Lord Vader! I'm certain of it! Just&hellip; minutes&hellip;?|Darth Vader and Ch'ord Sy'fon|<ref name="Rep" />}}
'''Ch'ord Sy'fon''' was a [[Color/Legends|brown]]-skinned [[Bothan]] [[Gender|male]] with light brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] who wore a light brown tunic with a collar.<ref name="Rep" /> Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">[[Republic 78|''Republic'' 78]] states that it occurs [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Republic'' 78 must take place around 19 BBY</ref> he encountered the former [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] [[Sagoro Autem]], who considered Sy'fon a friend, in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Rep" />

While the Bothan spoke with a group of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]], Autem approached him, asking for passage off-world as a favor Sy'fon owed him. The Bothan then granted the Human passage aboard the [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 Coruscant freighter]] ''[[Scimitar of Kelso]]'' to the planet [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and Autem departed.<ref name="Rep" />

[[Standard minute/Legends|Minutes]] before the ''Scimitar of Kelsa'' left, Sy'fon met with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and told him that Autem would be trying to leave aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] soon. However, before the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] could capture the Human, Autem sneaked aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] his "friend" had provided him and escaped.<ref name="Rep" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ch'ord Sy'fon appeared in the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse comic book]] [[Republic 78|''Republic'' 78]], the seventy&ndash;eight issue in the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' comic series, which released on [[October 19]], [[2005]]. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]], and the artwork was penciled by [[Luke Ross]].<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/10-451/Star-Wars-Republic-78|text=STAR WARS: REPUBLIC #78}}</ref>
